text: 新筑股份公告，公司拟向蜀道集团发行股份及支付现金购买蜀道清洁能源60%股权，同时向蜀道轨交集团、四川路桥出售川发磁浮100%股权等资产及新筑交科100%股权等资产。拟置入资产交易对价为56.03亿元，拟出售资产交易对价为14.55亿元，发行价格5.11元/股，发行数量9.05亿股。本次交易构成关联交易和重大资产重组，不构成重组上市，已获四川省国资委批准，尚需深交所审核通过及中国证监会同意注册。
text_en: Xinzhu Corporation announced that the company plans to issue shares and pay cash to Shudao Group to acquire a 60% equity interest in Shudao Clean Energy, and at the same time sell 100% equity interests in Chuanfa Maglev and other assets, as well as 100% equity interests in Xinzhu Jiaoke and other assets, to Shudao Rail Transit Group and Sichuan Road & Bridge. The proposed consideration for the assets to be acquired is 5.603 billion yuan, and the proposed consideration for the assets to be sold is 1.455 billion yuan, with an issue price of 5.11 yuan per share and an issue size of 905 million shares. This transaction constitutes a related-party transaction and a major asset restructuring, but does not constitute a reverse takeover. It has been approved by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of Sichuan Province and still requires approval by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and registration approval by the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
